question: Does removing one transformer layer from the compression-v1 student get INT8 <= 30 MB with acceptable held-out quality?
student: student-3x768: 3 layers, hidden 768, 12 heads, FFN 3072, gelu, dropout 0.1
init: pretrained BamiBERT; layer_map(12, 3) = 0-based [3, 7, 11] (1-based 4, 8, 12); embeddings, embedding LayerNorm and whole blocks copied exactly; fresh seeded heads (same convention as distillation-v2/compression-v1)
compression: position table truncated to 34 rows; vocabulary pruned to B-rank-8000 (8,338 rows, exact row copies), models/compression-v1/vocab/B-rank-8000 unchanged
training: distillation-v2 supervised recipe unchanged: encoder lr 5e-5, head lr 1e-3, batch 8, 40 epochs, warmup 0.1, weight decay 0.01, dropout 0.1, max grad norm 1.0, last epoch kept; same 723 training notes; seeds 1,2,3; same seeded batch order; no KD; no sweep.
rng_note: Heads are initialized after the encoder under set_seed(seed); a 3-layer encoder consumes fewer random draws, so head init differs from the 4-layer arm for the same seed. Batch order uses the same seed and data.
selection: none: no hyperparameter or checkpoint selection; test and probe-v1 are evaluation only.
